title: Servicios Aereos Estrella
description: sae.com.mx zoominfo.com/c/servicios-aéreos-estrella-s-a/457170292 Servicios Aéreos Estrella, S.A. de C.V. (SAE) is a Mexican business-aviation company and pioneer of executive aviation in Mexico with 30+ years of experience, based at Toluca International Airport — the main private-aviation gateway to Mexico City. It claims to be Latin America's largest FBO, with 12,000 m² of apron, 10,000 m² of hangar storage, four VIP lounges, a café/bar, VIP ground transport and an office next to immigration. Services include private jet charter and rental (from piston aircraft to long-range jets, plus discounted "Empty Legs"), aircraft management and administration, full handling/dispatch (permits, catering, documents, flight closures), aircraft storage and pet-friendly flights, operating 24/7 year-round.
